reviews_5s: does exactly what it is designed for.Son pequeños pero prácticos fáciles de guardar y limpiarWe have never had this size strainer among our kitchen gadgets. Got these for an activity that I was doing with my students so bought four sets. They worked great! They are sturdy (they held up to student use). After using them, I wondered why they hadn't been part of our kitchen. The two sizes just seem like they would be great to have for when the large strainer is just too much. Also, small enough they are easy to store. I am going to keep a set and then pass them out to my kids for their kitchens.Two simple strainers. Easy to store and hang together inside a cabinet for easy access.Perfect. Love the cleaning agent fir stainless steel appliancesWorks great for what I need them for. Perfect size. Fast shippingNice handles on small strainers , fine mesh for filtering, easy cleaning !Also needed one for the kitchen. So it worked out perfectly. 9/25/24.When I originally opened this package I thought I had made a mistake & wasn’t going to find much use for these smaller strainers! Boy was I wrong! I simply hold them to the side of the pot and drain the water using the strainer to catch anything that may slip out with the water. Super easy to use, doesn’t take up a colossal amount of space, easy to clean, and seems to be made well. Great product.good buy
reviews_1s: I ordered these and received them yesterday. I put them in the dishwasher to wash before using. These photos are how they came out. The listing states they are stainless steel. No they are some cheap alloy. You can see how the metal turned to black and then oxidized immediately. The mesh immediately rusted in the dishwasher. The 4th photo is the rust that came off from taping one strainer on the papertowl after taking it out of the dishwasher. I would not use these with food - #1 because they covered in rust, but also, who knows what kind of coating they have on them to look like shiny stainless if it comes off in the dishwasher. I will be reporting this to amazon as well.The larger of the two strainers was already broken when I opened the package. The wire was separated on one edge. Very lightweight and low quality.This rusted right away! I should've returned it, but by the time it occurred to me the return window had closed. In looking back now I see the product description says, "The stainless steel mesh won't rush even after multiple uses!" I should've read more closely. They weren't promising it wouldn't RUST, then were promising that it wouldn't RUSH. And so far that's held true. These little mesh strainers have not rushed.🤣Broken mesh both strainersIt is the worst thing I buy off Amazon I use it and it turn rustyfor 6.47 dollarThe ad for these strainers says, "Stainless steel mesh won't rust even after multiple uses." Good to know. I guess the folks at Chef Craft just wanted us to know so when we have to replace these when they start to rust, we will buy stainless steel instead of these. I bought mine last November 2022, and they started rusting in December. Now, they are unusable. Thanks for the heads up, Chef Craft.These strainers look fine out of the package, but went right into the trash after coming out of the dishwasher. I might’ve hand washed them had I’d known but then I wouldn’t have bought strainers that need to be hand washed in the first place! I don’t think these are food safe with all the stuff flaking off the metal. Horrible quality.I should have known from the cost that these would be a terrible purchase but I bought them anyways. After a single use, they rusted. They weren’t sitting in water or anything. Hand washed and laid out to dry, and rust started to appear. Don’t waste your money on these.Not very durable. I was using these for the strawberry DNA extraction lab, and one of my students managed to break it by pushing the substance through the strainer with a plastic spoon. The mesh detached from the main ring. Not a good buy at all.These strainers are the cheapest made product I have ever purchased. They rusted after the first wash and are poorly made. I would give them ZERO stars if I could! Waste of money!
